name: base1-parasite-weapon-retreat
scope: Original base1 BSP/AAS and movers/items/barrels, original monsters removed, one vulnerable native Parasite. One-time loaded Shotgun/inventory setup before ordinary play. No forced model decision, god or later give/teleport.
acceptance: Fresh authoritative inventory and loaded Shotgun when use Machinegun or use Blaster is requested for parasite_retreat_range
At least two selected-weapon firing retreat frames and two actual steps away from the observed Parasite
Native MOD_MACHINEGUN or MOD_BLASTER damage after selection and exactly one selected-weapon native Parasite kill
No death, teammate, map transition or additional gameplay intervention
Ordinary campaign movement after the kill, acknowledged distinct seeds, timescale 2, two isolated servers/clients and stable source fingerprint
remaining_scope: Low-health weapon switches, HyperBlaster/Railgun, mixed groups and other maps need separate native acceptance.
